newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia SIR20 rubber steady in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia SIR20 rubber steady in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were steady in slow late trading on Monday following fresh foreign enquiries, dealers said.
"U.S. buying late on Friday and fresh foreign enquiries from Singapore and Europe have kept sentiment steady," one dealer in Jakarta said.
Dealers said U.S. firms were heard buying SIR20 fob Jambi at 54.75 cents/lb and fob Palembang at 54.50 cents/lb late on Friday both for December/January deliveries.
They said demand was likely to edge up in the coming days as prices had already reached bottom.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for December/January shipments remained at 54.75-55.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Jambi and Pontianak, at 55.50-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 55.00-55.50 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang.
One latex dealer in the west Javanese city of Bandung said demand for high amoniac grade latex remained generally soft.
He said high amoniac grade latex, with 60 percent dry rubber content, was last traded at 2,200 rupiah/kg for October delieveries against the previous 2,230 rupiah.
